mentions.name: Release Flow Automation
mentions.description: This project automates the release flow, targeting the gap where AI agents and code-writing harnesses have made creating PRs and writing code cheap, but code review remains slow and difficult.
mentions.problem: Creating PRs and writing code has become easy and cheap with AI agents, but reviewing code is still challenging and consumes most of the author's time.
mentions.source_excerpt: so i am working on the automation of release flow , today creating pr is very easy writing code had become very cheap using ai agents and other harnesses around it but reviewing the code is still challenging
